notes: FC 27 rosters and ratings as of 12 September 2026 (EA ratings feed); Opta snapshot 10 September 2026, clubs added by data:reconcile carry their own retrieval date.

The feed names clubs and leagues without ids: data/source-map.json ties them to this reference (npm run data:reconcile). Clubs added by the reconcile tool have a local id (900001+) when no older snapshot gives their EA team id.

Leagues the feed lacks stay unavailable; continental-cup groupings are not leagues: their clubs keep the league this reference has them in, or stay out. Partial licensed league rosters are retained as partial.
Team tiers are game-defined from verified Opta scores; club colors are simplified sourced palettes, not a claim of exact seasonal jerseys.
